basis: Gonadal failure and skeletal abnormalities define; hearing impairment and learning disability each 30–79%; thyroiditis, hypertension and steatosis are separately coded conditions.
Ischemic necrosis directly destroys bone; interrupted blood supply alone does not establish a separate vascular disorder.
Malignant vascular neoplasm arising in the spleen; no additional organ involvement established for the unqualified concept.
Pure personality disorder without defined damage to an organ axis.
Disordered calcium absorption and urinary calcium handling define the condition; stones are separately diagnosed and are not added.
B-lymphoblastic leukemia affects hematopoietic cells and marrow; leukemia alone does not establish an immune mechanism axis.
Persistence of reproductive ducts with cryptorchidism in otherwise normally virilized males; no defining dysfunction of an included organ axis.
Defined as nervous system disease of vascular etiology; both nervous tissue and its vasculature are defining locations.
Umbrella for ear, nose and throat diseases; nose and pharyngeal/laryngeal airways belong to pulmonary.
Vertebral flattening, scoliosis and finger contractures define this skeletal dysplasia.
Alcohol-associated fibrosis and architectural destruction of liver; other alcohol-related diseases are separate conditions.
Mycobacterial infection predominantly affecting lungs; rifampicin resistance does not change the usual organ distribution.
Corticospinal degeneration defines; peroneal muscle atrophy and pes cavus occur in 30–79%; urinary symptoms and dysphagia do not establish urinary or GI tissue damage.
Arterial calcification with coronary ischemia and cardiac failure defines; nephrocalcinosis and rickets occur in only 5–29%.
Trisomy-18-like developmental and skeletal malformation syndrome; sparse annotation leaves the phenotype and frequencies of other organ defects uncertain.
Autoimmune cutaneous dermatomyositis; ILD occurs in over half and may progress rapidly; muscle involvement can be absent or mild.
Malignant granular cell tumor located in skin; Schwannian differentiation alone does not establish nervous system damage.
Familial actinic keratosis is a keratinizing skin disorder; no additional organ disease is established.
External auditory canal atresia and vertical talus define; hypertelorism is facial morphology, while strabismus is only occasional.
Developmental delay defines; hearing loss 2/3, strabismus 3/6, renal agenesis 1/3; cardiac and skeletal defects (~1/3) omitted because of cap; small cohort.
Necrosis directly destroys renal papillae and may impair urinary concentration or cause obstruction and kidney failure.
Gyrate atrophy of choroid and retina defines ocular degeneration; no supplied evidence establishes an associated metabolic disorder.
NDD and agammaglobulinemia define; optic atrophy 2/4 and ptosis 3/4; respiratory failure with hypercapnia does not establish intrinsic pulmonary damage.
Mitochondrial encephalopathy with cerebral atrophy; hearing loss and optic atrophy each 1/1 reported patient; aspiration pneumonia is separate; frequency evidence is limited.
Inherited steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome with glomerulosclerosis and frequent kidney failure; no evidence of an immune-mediated mechanism.
